# Flash Forward Foundation

> Flash Forward Foundation is a student-run 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 39-3605570) in Bellevue, Washington. Student interns build $5.17 solar study lights and send them through partner organizations to students who have no electricity after dark. As of October 2026, 72 lights have been delivered: 42 to Brighten Haiti, 15 to Loksadhana in Maharashtra, India, and 15 to Malaika in Kalebuka, DR Congo.

## About the organization

- [Our story](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/about/): Who we are and how the organization runs.
- [Leadership](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/about/team/): The student executives, advisors and interns.
- [Nonprofit status](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/nonprofit-status/): 501(c)(3) public charity, EIN 39-3605570, with IRS documents.
- [FAQ](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/faq/): Common questions about the program.
- [Contact](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/contact/): Reach the team at about@flashforwardfoundation.org.

## The program

- [Our work](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/our-work/): What student interns build and where the lights go.
- [The study light](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/our-work/the-light/): The $5.17 solar light, part by part.
- [How a light is built](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/our-work/how-we-build/): The workshop steps from printing to packing.
- [Where the lights go](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/our-work/where/): Map of partner deliveries.
- [Our impact](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/impact/): The program record as of October 2026.
- [Program record](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/news/program-record/): 72 study lights delivered to partners in Haiti, India and the DR Congo.
- [Photos and videos](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/our-work/photos-and-videos/): Build sessions, finished lights, deliveries and workshops.

## Ways to help

- [Donate](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/donate/): $5.17 covers the parts for one light.
- [Internships](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/get-involved/internship/): Student internships in Bellevue.
- [Start a fundraiser](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/news/start-a-fundraiser/): Run a group fundraiser for study lights.
- [Get involved](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/get-involved/): More ways to help.
